They contribute to the microbicidal activity of phagocytes, regulation of signal transduction and gene expression, and the oxidative damage to biopolymers." [GOC:mah]

"Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of an alcohol stimulus." [GOC:pr, PMID:24014527]
"Any process involved in the conversion of one or more primary RNA transcripts into one or more mature RNA molecules." [GOC:mah]
